ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the metered fare as billed; no refund. Note on record that the off-route segment is explained by the documented Tampines Expressway accident — no driver fault, no account flag.

segment_findings.reason: RD-4(a): off-route segment 09:04–09:07 (+1.76 km) is explained by a Traffic Incident — Accident on Tampines Expressway, lanes blocked, reported 08:44, 0 m from the optimal route (within 300 m), reported before the segment start and active during the trip window [F13]. Corroborated by RD-4(b): expressway speed band 1 (0–9 km/h) covering 08:46–09:04 [F10]. Exempt; no refund.

rejected_claims.reason: RD-4 exemption applies on the traffic evidence [F13][F10]; when the deviation has a reasonable cause, a pre-trip consent under RD-5 is not required. The absence of route-change chat [F7][F8] therefore does not make the segment non-exempt.

RydeTAXI is metered; the extra distance arises solely from the exempt segment [F3][F13], and the residual difference between billed excess [F4] and segment extra_km is within the ≤0.25 km map-matching residual that RD-2 does not refund.
